statement: phase_a.tokens = 3,413,019,479 is the sum of per-document token counts (document tokens, no separators). It is not the stream token count. Stream tokens include one EOS (ID 0) after every document and equal the token-file sizes / 2.

stream_tokens_from_file_sizes.method: sum of os.path.getsize(token file) // 2 over the 9 uint16 token files listed in shards.json (train 536,870,912 x 6 + 188,888,582; validation 3,218,204; test 2,646,592); equal to the per-split stream_tokens fields of the annotated record

tool_change: tools/full_recount.py schema j1.full-recount.v2 writes a totals block (document_tokens_total, separator_tokens_total, stream_tokens_total) beside phase_a.tokens; the committed v1 record above is unchanged
quoting_rule: any statement of the launch corpus size must say which figure it quotes: 3,413,019,479 document tokens or 3,415,978,850 stream tokens
